MouseSettings(bool, float, float, float, HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>?)

Initializes a new instance of the InputSettings.MouseSettings struct with custom detection, move threshold, and wheel threshold values. Other values are set to their defaults: MinPressCount = 2, MinPressInterval = 1f, MinUsedDuration = 0.5f.

public MouseSettings(bool detection, float moveThreshold, float wheelThreshold, float selectionCooldownDuration = 2, HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>? exceptionButtons = null)

Parameters

detection bool

Indicates whether mouse detection is enabled.

moveThreshold float

The minimum movement threshold to consider the mouse as "used".

wheelThreshold float

The minimum mouse wheel movement threshold to consider the mouse as "used".

selectionCooldownDuration float

Specifies the cooldown duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Default is 2 seconds.

exceptionButtons HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>

The set of mouse buttons that will never select this device, even if pressed.

MouseSettings(HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>, float, HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>?)

DefaultMouseWheelThreshold

Field Value

float

Detection

Indicates whether the input device can be changed to mouse.

public bool Detection

Field Value

bool

Remarks

Default is true Does not affect WasUsedRaw() values. It does affect the automatic system in InputSystem to switch between devices.

ExceptionButtons

The set of gamepad buttons that will never select this device, even if pressed.

public readonly HashSet<ShapeMouseButton> ExceptionButtons

Field Value

HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>

MinPressCount

The minimum number of mouse button presses required, within the specified interval, to consider the mouse device as "used".

public int MinPressCount

Field Value

int

Remarks

Default is 2 presses within 1 second. Does work in combination with MinUsedDuration but has a lower priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MinPressInterval

The time interval (in seconds) from the first mouse button press within which MouseMinPressCount must be reached for the mouse device to be considered "used".

public float MinPressInterval

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 1 second. Does work in combination with MinUsedDuration but has a lower priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MinUsedDuration

The minimum duration (in seconds) of consecutive mouse use (movement or holding at least one button down) required to consider the mouse device as "used".

public float MinUsedDuration

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 0.5 seconds Does work in combination with MinPressCount / MinPressInterval but has a higher priority. MinUsedDuration system will be checked first and if it triggers, MinPressCount / MinPressInterval system will be reset as well and not checked in the same frame.

MoveThreshold

The minimum movement threshold to consider the mouse as "used".

public float MoveThreshold

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is DefaultMouseMoveThreshold Even if Detection is set to false, MoveThreshold will still be used for WasUsedRaw() system.

SelectionButtons

The set of gamepad buttons that can be used to select this device. When set and not empty, all other means of selection are disabled.

public readonly HashSet<ShapeMouseButton> SelectionButtons

Field Value

HashSet<ShapeMouseButton>

SelectionCooldownDuration

Specifies the duration (in seconds) after this device is selected during which no other input device can be selected. Used to prevent rapid switching between input devices.

public float SelectionCooldownDuration

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is 2 seconds. Zero and negative values disable the cooldown.

WheelThreshold

The minimum mouse wheel movement threshold to consider the mouse as "used".

public float WheelThreshold

Field Value

float

Remarks

Default is DefaultMouseWheelThreshold Even if Detection is set to false, WheelThreshold will still be used for WasUsedRaw() system.

Gets a value indicating whether exception buttons are enabled for this device. Returns true if ExceptionButtons is not null and contains at least one button. These buttons will never select this device, even if pressed.

PressCountEnabled

Gets a value indicating whether press count detection is enabled for the mouse. Detection is enabled when MinPressCount is greater than 1 and MinPressInterval is greater than 0.

bool

SelectionButtonsEnabled

Gets a value indicating whether selection buttons are enabled for this device. Returns true if SelectionButtons is not null and contains at least one button. When enabled, the device can only be selected with the specified special buttons.

bool

UsedDurationEnabled

Indicates whether used duration detection is enabled (requires MinUsedDuration to be greater than zero).
